create.name: Llyn Roberts
create.bio:
Llyn "Cedar" Roberts first learned Reiki in 1988 from John Harvey Gray, who had trained under Hawayo Takata, and became a Reiki master teacher in 1993. In the 1980s she studied with the Tibetan teacher Chögyam Trungpa Rinpoche and completed a graduate degree at Naropa University that joined Buddhist and Western psychology. From the 1990s she spent long periods learning from Quechua healers in the Ecuadorian Andes and from Amazonian and Siberian shamans, and for many years she led small groups on journeys to meet Indigenous elders, including work alongside John Perkins at Dream Change.

Out of these strands she developed Shamanic Reiki, a way of joining hands-on energy work with nature-based ritual, journeying and contemplative practice. Shamanic Reiki Worldwide, which she founded, runs a home-based apprenticeship lasting up to three years, taught online by Llyn and a faculty of senior students, and she also leads quiet residential retreats in nature and teaches at Omega. Her books include Shamanic Reiki, written with Robert Levy, Shapeshifting into Higher Consciousness, and two titles co-written with Sandra Ingerman, Speaking with Nature and Walking Through Darkness.

books.title: Shamanic Reiki: Expanded Ways of Working with Universal Life Force Energy
books.author: Llyn Roberts, Robert Levy
books.description: Two practitioners show how shamanic methods such as journeying, working with helping spirits and nature-based ceremony can be brought into Reiki practice. Exercises guide readers through combining the two approaches for themselves and others.

books.title: Speaking with Nature: Awakening to the Deep Wisdom of the Earth
books.author: Sandra Ingerman, Llyn Roberts
books.description: Written with Sandra Ingerman, this book passes on messages the authors received from animals, plants, places and elements, each followed by simple practices for listening to the natural world. It won a Nautilus Gold award in 2015.

books.title: Shapeshifting into Higher Consciousness: Heal and Transform Yourself and Our World with Ancient Shamanic and Modern Methods
books.author: Llyn Roberts
books.description: Drawing on her time with Indigenous teachers, Roberts turns the shamanic idea of shapeshifting into everyday practices for changing how we see ourselves and act in the world. The book links personal change with care for the earth.

books.title: Walking through Darkness: A Nature-Based Path to Navigating Suffering and Loss
books.author: Sandra Ingerman, Llyn Roberts
books.description: A second collaboration with Sandra Ingerman about the hard seasons of life, the dark nights of the soul. The two authors trade stories from their own lives and from nature, offering ways to find direction and steadiness when the path is unclear.

courses.title: The Wisdom of Reiki Conference
courses.description: A weekend gathering at Omega's Rhinebeck campus with several Reiki teachers, open to beginners and masters alike. Llyn leads a Shamanic Reiki journey in which participants receive one of her Reiki Secrets symbols, alongside hands-on practice and talks from the other faculty.
courses.price: Member $365 USD, standard $405 USD (tuition; accommodation extra)

courses.title: Shamanic Reiki Master Entry Year Apprenticeship
courses.description: A year-long, home-based training running from January to December 2027, with an online library, live sessions with Llyn and the faculty, a personal mentor and practicums with clients or with the land. Reiki training is included, so newcomers can join.
courses.price: $2,650 USD on the payment plan ($650 USD deposit); paying in full saves $155 USD

courses.title: Wild Wisdom Residential Retreat
courses.description: Four nights in a farmhouse at Shantigar in Rowe, Massachusetts, spent mostly outdoors and unplugged. Days mix quiet sitting, wandering, journalling, rest and circle sharing, with simple invitations to open the senses to the land.
courses.price: $1,095 USD (facilitation and four nights' lodging; food not included)

Social accounts other than @llynroberts belong to her school, Shamanic Reiki Worldwide (she founded it and it carries her method); counted, but the total is far under 100k either way.
Omega's Wisdom of Reiki Conference is shared with William Lee Rand (plan exists), Nicholas Pearson (rank 42, this chunk), Brett Bevell, Andrea Kennedy, Donnabelle Casis and Jason Wood.
Co-authored books with Sandra Ingerman, who is already listed on Spiritpedia: link the books to both if the system supports it.
Wild Wisdom retreat starts 11 Nov 2026, close to the sprint date; drop it if the live insert happens after that.
Availability set to worldwide: the apprenticeship is home-based online and her in-person retreats move between venues; no fixed base where she sees people is published.
Reiki and shamanic pages use 'healing' language in general terms; I found no condition named on the pages used.
left_out: Evolving Master EV1 and EV2 programmes: open only to graduates of the earlier years (EV2 page still shows 2025 dates).
The Good Remembering (ISBN 1846940389 / 1780990847): amazon.com /dp/ returned 500 with curl and WebFetch, so not confirmed.
Omega clips under two minutes (How Shapeshifting Helps Us Heal, How to Communicate With Nature, Access Creative Forces) and the duplicate HD upload of the Hoh Rainforest video.
Free guided audio journey: only given in exchange for a newsletter sign-up, so not listed as a free resource.
Practitioner directory and Altar Circle pages: about her graduates, not her own offerings.
